title: Invoice attachments from mailbox to fields
text: Uploads every email attachment from a mailbox one by one and forces structured fields out of each, flagging whether it is an invoice and pulling company, date, number and line items.

title: Basketball schedule photo to calendar file
text: Reads a photographed printed team schedule and converts it into an ICS calendar file with one event per game.

title: Gamebook PDFs split into playable sections
text: Parses scanned gamebook PDFs from an archive, splits them into numbered sections with their choices, and wraps them in a presenter so the book can be played through.

title: Tax PDFs to JSON then aggregated
text: Writes a command-line pipeline that turns tax-related PDFs into flexible JSON records, then iterates a script until it can aggregate every differing JSON file consistently.

title: Bank files categorized into rules
text: Imports downloaded QFX and CSV bank exports, builds categorization rules and per-transaction fingerprints, and decodes cryptic statement merchants into a subscriptions view.

title: Invoices matched and categorized to ledger
text: Pulls invoices from mail and bank transactions, associates each expense with its invoice, and categorizes entries in a plain-text accounting ledger, leaving a small remainder to resolve manually.

title: Meeting transcripts to structured notes
text: Corrects mangled names and terms in auto-transcripts against an error table, then emits templated summaries with decisions and action items and pushes tasks into a to-do app.

title: Audiobook series to character database
text: Transcribes a bestselling audiobook series, runs a local text-analysis pass over the transcripts for one character's appearances, and loads the results into a database.

title: Legal PDFs copied into review spreadsheet
text: Copies data from varied, partly unsearchable PDF documents into a spreadsheet for an attorney to check page by page, replacing manual copy-paste.

title: Ebook dump sorted into folder tree
text: Sorts a large dump of epub files into folders by language, genre, sub-genre and author so a small reader device becomes browsable.

title: Scraped job listings sorted by interest
text: Takes scraped job listings from a database and categorizes them against stated interests, producing a prioritized list of the new postings worth reading.

title: Local files organized into folders
text: Merges multiple markdown files into one and sorts a pile of photos into folders by writing small scripts against local files.

title: Handwritten scholarship forms to spreadsheet
text: Ingests handwritten scholarship application forms by optical recognition into a spreadsheet, extracting the text fields and attached images row by row.

title: Handwritten note photos transcribed in vault
text: Transcribes photographed handwritten pages inside a notes vault, fixes recognition errors, adds markdown formatting and places the text beneath the image in the chosen note.

title: Forest ranger diary transcribed and indexed
text: Transcribes and indexes scanned pages of a handwritten 1927-1945 forest ranger diary into a database behind a public website.

title: Magazine archive summarized into catalog
text: Summarizes raw OCR text from millions of donated magazine PDFs into lists of contained articles and authors so the archive can be cataloged and searched.

title: Sanborn map sheets to street JSON
text: Reads images of historical fire insurance map sheets and extracts street names, rail lines and house numbers as JSON for a deterministic georeferencing step.

title: Emails turned into tasks and sheet rows
text: Extracts item names, dates, amounts and confirmation numbers from inbox emails, from text or screenshots, then sends them to tasks, calendar or spreadsheet rows.

title: 700-page PDF tables to CSV
text: Extracts the tables from a 700-page PDF into CSV files page by page, with a prompt that preserves empty cells so columns do not shift.

title: Eleven thousand receipts mined for egg prices
text: Extracts line items from 11,345 scanned receipts, emails and images spanning 25 years, locates the egg purchases, and builds a price history from garbled thermal prints.

title: PDF contact data merged into JSON files
text: Reads an exported PDF of a contact page and updates seven fields across two dozen JSON files with the newer values after trying several parsing routes.

title: Personal documents OCRed and tax forms parsed
text: Reads and recognizes the text in all scanned PDFs in a personal document manager and parses tax forms written in three languages.

title: Grandparents' wartime letters transcribed
text: Transcribes a family collection of handwritten letters between grandparents during the Second World War into typed text, with some trouble keeping pages in order.

title: Notion page fields pulled to JSON
text: Opens a Notion page through a scripted browser and extracts the requested text fields into JSON.

title: Tax PDFs read and typed into web form
text: Reads local tax PDF files and writes the extracted numbers into the fields of a tax-filing web page through a browser extension.

title: Unsaved wiki edit recovered from browser
text: Pulls an unsaved long text edit out of a frozen browser's internal storage and filesystem objects, recovering hours of typing before it is lost.

title: Notion export deduplicated into markdown vault
text: Cleans a Notion export by removing duplicate and index pages and organizing the remaining notes into a tidy folder of markdown files.

title: Downloads folder of 1500 files organized
text: Sorts a downloads folder holding about 1,500 loose files into an organized structure of topical folders, a job left undone for lack of patience.

title: Bank statement expenses classified for VAT
text: Classifies expenses from a bank statement CSV for tax reporting and fills in the spreadsheet an accountant sends.

title: Interview transcripts analyzed and coded
text: Organizes and analyzes qualitative interview transcripts stored as text documents, pulling out themes across the files.

title: Prescription history unified from medical records
text: Reads historical medical records and scanned PDF pages including tables and continued passages to unify a single prescription history.

title: Spoken ramblings structured into notes
text: Takes recorded stream-of-consciousness voice memos from walks and organizes the transcribed thoughts into structured notes.

title: Business cards scanned into contact fields
text: Reads a photographed business card and pulls out the contact details as structured fields to pair with a voice note about the conversation.

title: Faculty resumes parsed for verification
text: Reads about 100 four-page applicant forms listing scores, work history and publications, structuring the claims so they can be checked against reality.

title: Bank CSV matched to emailed invoices
text: Links each exported bank transaction to its invoice in an inbox by searching mail and downloading the attachments, after about four hours of setup.

title: Tax forms renamed and details extracted
text: Renames a folder of tax-form PDFs, extracts all tax-relevant figures from each statement, and compiles income and deductions into a web view plus accountant package.

title: Datasheet curve screenshot into data tool
text: Converts a screenshot of a datasheet curve into an interactive tool that reads values off the plot, after four attempts in one conversation.

title: Mailbox archive indexed for browsing
text: Preprocesses a set of exported emails into a searchable web page so ordinary readers can browse and search the mailbox.

title: Screenshot pile sorted into project folders
text: Sorts about 1,400 desktop screenshots into named project folders from a reference document and sample images, renames them folder by folder, and flags sensitive items for deletion.

title: Bilingual purchase orders to structured records
text: Reads bilingual Arabic-English purchase order PDFs and extracts roles, rates, dates and line items as JSON into warehouse tables for finance staff to review.

title: Pension records drafted as transcriptions
text: Produces draft transcriptions of handwritten historical records such as Revolutionary War pension files, which are then compared line by line with the images and corrected.

title: Trial papers mined for data elements
text: Extracts 160 predefined data elements from ten open-access randomized trial PDFs, uploading each paper and prompting for each element, then checks accuracy against human extraction.

title: Agency AI inventories merged into one dataset
text: Finds each federal agency's published inventory spreadsheet, downloads the differently formatted files, and merges them with a script into one consolidated dataset for a news story.

title: Expense receipt PDFs to import CSV
text: Turns batches of up to ten expense receipt PDFs into a CSV for database import and renames each PDF with a vendor category mapping.

title: Receipt PDFs entered as ledger transactions
text: Reads PDF receipts and enters them as transactions in a plain-text accounting ledger while checking the books balance.

title: Retirement account transfer history reconstructed
text: Reorganizes years of accumulated tax spreadsheets and tracks down the history of money moved between institutions, withdrawals and conversions in retirement accounts.

title: Screenshots of reading lists into catalogue
text: Turns screenshots of manga and manhwa reading lists into entries for an on-device library catalogue instead of a messy spreadsheet.

title: Side-project posts categorized into clone lists
text: Parses 968 public launch posts from a forum and groups them into categories and lists of clones of popular apps.

title: Antidrug antibody rates from 3730 trial papers
text: Reads thousands of clinical-trial PDFs against a written rules document to extract each paper's anti-drug antibody rate, yielding usable values for 909 papers.

title: Messy PDFs and web pages into JSON tables
text: Infers the schema of table regions detected in messy PDFs and HTML pages, then extracts thousands of rows to JSON, CSV or Parquet deterministically.

title: Excel sheet converted to structured format
text: Converts an Excel workbook into a structured data format through repeated prompting over about four hours, ending with code that broke earlier fixes.

title: Invoice PDFs attached to bookkeeping records
text: Reads a folder of PDFs, works out the VAT on each, and attaches the figures to matching bank-fed invoice records in an accounting service.

title: Accountant spreadsheet mapped to tax portal
text: Interprets an accountant's Excel summary for a household with employee and freelance income and translates each figure into the fields the tax portal expects.

title: Player stats scraped from ten sites
text: Scrapes player statistics from more than ten sources, from a league's official site to an encyclopedia, into one structured set for a fan site.

title: Blu-ray shop catalogue scraped to database
text: Scrapes a JavaScript-heavy shop's movie section into a local database that backs a watchlist with price-range alerts.
